their.definition: Belonging to or associated with people previously mentioned.

there.definition: In, at, or to that place or position.

affect.definition: To have an influence on or produce a change in.

effect.definition: A change that is a result or consequence of an action.

its.definition: Belonging to or associated with a thing previously mentioned.

it's.definition: Shortened contraction of 'it is' or 'it has'.

your.definition: Belonging to or associated with any person in address.

whose.definition: Belonging to or associated with which person.

who's.definition: Shortened contraction of 'who is' or 'who has'.

accept.definition: Consent to receive a thing offered or agree to terms.

except.definition: Not including; other than; apart from.

advice.definition: Guidance or recommendations offered with regard to prudent action.

advise.definition: Offer suggestions or recommendations about the best course of action.

principal.definition: First in order of importance; the head of a school or organization.
principal.hint: Head of school or main priority

principle.definition: A fundamental truth, doctrine, or moral rule of conduct.

compliment.definition: A polite expression of praise, affection, or admiration.

complement.definition: A thing that completes, matches, or brings something to perfection.

stationary.definition: Not moving, fixed in place, or not intended to be moved.

stationery.definition: Writing materials including paper, envelopes, and pens.

weather.definition: The state of the atmosphere with respect to wind, temperature, and rain.

whether.definition: Expressing a doubt or choice between alternatives.

desert.definition: A dry, barren area of land with little water or vegetation.

dessert.definition: The sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.
dessert.hint: Sweet treat (double S for Sweet Stuff)

past.definition: Gone by in time and no longer existing; time before the present.

passed.definition: Moved beyond a point or succeeded in an examination.

sight.definition: The faculty or power of seeing; a view.

site.definition: An area of ground on which a building or project is constructed.

cite.definition: Quote a book or author as evidence for an argument.

conscience.definition: An inner feeling or voice viewed as acting as a guide to right or wrong.

conscious.definition: Aware of and responding to one's surroundings; awake.

precede.definition: Come before something in order, position, or time.

proceed.definition: Begin or continue a course of action.

lose.definition: Be deprived of or cease to have or retain something.

loose.definition: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; free from restraint.

quiet.definition: Making little or no noise; calm and serene.

quite.definition: To the utmost or most absolute extent; completely or rather.

separate.definition: Forming or viewed as an independent unit; to disconnect.

accommodate.definition: Provide lodging or sufficient space for; fit in with.

necessary.definition: Required to be done, achieved, or present; essential.

embarrass.definition: Cause someone to feel awkward, self-conscious, or ashamed.

harass.definition: Subject to aggressive pressure, intimidation, or torment.

guarantee.definition: A formal promise or assurance of quality or performance.

jewelry.definition: Personal ornaments such as necklaces, rings, or bracelets.

judgment.definition: The ability to make considered decisions or come to conclusions.

maneuver.definition: A movement or series of moves requiring skill and care.

occasion.definition: A particular event or the time at which something takes place.

occurred.definition: Happened or took place in the past.

privilege.definition: A special right, advantage, or immunity granted to a person.

schedule.definition: A plan that gives expected times for different things to happen.

vacuum.definition: A space entirely devoid of matter; a suction cleaner.

rhythm.definition: A strong, regular, repeated pattern of movement or sound.

subtle.definition: So delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe.

doubt.definition: A feeling of uncertainty or lack of conviction.

pneumonia.definition: Lung inflammation caused by bacterial or viral infection.

psychology.definition: The scientific study of the human mind and its functions.

bureaucracy.definition: A system of government in which decisions are made by state officials.

maintenance.definition: The process of preserving or keeping something in good condition.

pronunciation.definition: The manner in which a word or language is spoken.

calendar.definition: A chart or series of pages showing the days, weeks, and months.

receive.definition: Be given, presented with, or paid something.
receive.hint: Rule: 'I before E except after C'

weird.definition: Suggesting something supernatural; unearthly or strange.

foreign.definition: Of, from, in, or characteristic of a country other than one's own.
